verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a communications platform that stores calls, messages and voicemails, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented retention policies, deletion APIs or purge controls. Generic mentions of 'data management' APIs, reading call logs, SMS 'compliance tools' and app permission scopes are adjacent at best and get no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
